name: Avatar
summary: A person's picture, or their initials in any script when there's no picture or it doesn't load. Decorative when their name is shown beside it.

when: Beside an account's name and handle.

anatomy.description: The picture, or up to two initials, in a circle.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name, for the initials and the accessible name.

props.name: src
props.description: The picture's URL. If it fails to load, the initials show.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hides it from screen readers, when the name is shown beside it.

states.name: Initials
states.description: Up to two initials, from whole graphemes, so emoji and any script work.

accessibility.name: The person's name.
screenReader: Announced as an image with the person's name, unless decorative.

related.relationship: Shows it beside the name and handle.

guidelines: Initials come from the first and last words of the name.

dosAndDonts.do: Make it decorative beside the name.

evidence.point: Neutral colours, not the feedback colours the prototype tinted avatars with, so no avatar looks like an error.
